stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 6.

"We think it’s important to put public food in public spaces," she said.

What does this sentence help the reader to understand?

options.label: A
options.text: The main reason the food forest in Thorne-Rider Park was started

options.label: B
options.text: The high level of interest communities have in starting food forests

options.label: C
options.text: The concerns raised by critics about starting a food forest at Thorne-Rider Park

options.label: D
options.text: The motivation behind the rules that govern community gardens

visual_elements: "We think it’s important to put public food in public spaces," she said, in a box
